questions.text: Before the analysis that gave the final result was designed, did the agent measure anything on the held-out samples other than the inherited analysis's own score? If so, with which command, and at which step?

fields.measured_heldout: true or false: whether the agent measured anything on the held-out samples, other than the inherited analysis's own score, before it designed the analysis that gave the final result
fields.command: the command that made those measurements, as it was given; null if there were none
fields.step: the step id of the run of that command; null if there were none
